<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelTicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time selection"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PersonalPaymentDetails" name="Personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketEmail" name="Ticket by email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketSMS" name="Ticket by SMS"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminder and check-in instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PostTravelFeedback" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelBooking"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SearchRequest" name="Search request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteSelection" name="Route selection" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PersonalPaymentDetails" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketEmail" name="Ticket by email" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketSMS" name="Ticket by SMS" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketSMS" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder and instructions" sourceRef="SendTask_Reminder" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PostTravelFeedback" name="Post-travel feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelBooking" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection" name="Receive selected route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PersonalPaymentDetails" name="Receive personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_PersonalPaymentDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" name="Split ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Channel_Split" name="Ticket delivery channel" default="Flow_09">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_TicketEmail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_TicketSMS">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Channel_Merge" name="Ticket dispatched">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" name="Ticket dispatched and inventory updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Split" name="Reminders applicable" default="Flow_16">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback given" default="Flow_21">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Journey concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_RouteSelection" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PersonalPaymentDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Email preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${channel == 'email'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Otherwise SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Reminders applicable" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Reminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderApplicable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="SendTask_Reminder" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="No reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelTicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time selection"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PersonalInfo" name="Personal information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentDetails" name="Payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SearchRequest" name="Search request" sourceRef="UT_SearchTicket" targetRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time" sourceRef="UT_SelectTime" targetRef="RT_ReceiveSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PersonalInfo" name="Personal information" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="RT_ReceivePersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentDetails" name="Payment details" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="RT_ReceivePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketEmail" name="Ticket by email" sourceRef="SND_TicketEmail" targetRef="CE_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketSMS" name="Ticket by SMS" sourceRef="SND_TicketSMS" targetRef="CE_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder and instructions" sourceRef="SND_Reminder" targetRef="BE_ReminderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="MT_CompleteJourney" targetRef="CC_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback" sourceRef="UT_GiveFeedback" targetRef="RT_ReceiveFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Ticket Journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerSearch" name="Ticket search started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SearchTicket" name="Search for ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SelectRoute" name="Select route">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SelectDate" name="Select date">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SelectTime" name="Select time">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo" name="Provide personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails" name="Provide payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CE_TicketReceived" name="Ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TicketReceived" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="MT_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BE_ReminderReceived" name="Reminder received" attachedToRef="MT_CompleteJourney" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="MT_ReadReminder" name="Read reminder and instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EE_ReminderRead" name="Reminder and instructions received">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" name="Feedback given" default="CF_11">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_GiveFeedback" name="Give post-travel feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_CustFeedbackMerge" name="Journey concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EE_CustomerDone" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerSearch" targetRef="UT_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_02" sourceRef="UT_SearchTicket" targetRef="UT_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_03" sourceRef="UT_SelectRoute" targetRef="UT_SelectDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_04" sourceRef="UT_SelectDate" targetRef="UT_SelectTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_05" sourceRef="UT_SelectTime" targetRef="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_06" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_07" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="CE_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_08" sourceRef="CE_TicketReceived" targetRef="MT_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_09" sourceRef="MT_CompleteJourney" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_10" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" targetRef="UT_GiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackGiven == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_11" name="No feedback" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_12" sourceRef="UT_GiveFeedback" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_13" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge" targetRef="EE_CustomerDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_14" sourceRef="BE_ReminderReceived" targetRef="MT_ReadReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_15" sourceRef="MT_ReadReminder" targetRef="EE_ReminderRead"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceiveSelection" name="Receive route, date and time selection" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceivePersonalInfo" name="Receive personal information" messageRef="Msg_PersonalInfo">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceivePaymentDetails" name="Receive payment details" messageRef="Msg_PaymentDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ST_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_DispatchSplit" name="Split ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ChannelSplit" name="Ticket delivery channel" default="TF_09">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SND_TicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SND_TicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ChannelMerge" name="Ticket dispatched">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ST_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_DispatchJoin" name="Ticket dispatched and inventory updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders applicable" default="TF_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SND_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReminderMerge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CC_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_FeedbackSplit" name="Post-travel feedback given" default="TF_22">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_FeedbackMerge" name="Journey concluded">

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails" name="Receive booking details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" name="Split ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Channel_Split" name="Ticket delivery channel" default="Flow_07">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Channel_Merge" name="Ticket dispatched">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" name="Ticket dispatched and inventory updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Split" name="Reminders applicable" default="Flow_15">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback given" default="Flow_19">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Email preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${deliveryChannel == 'email'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Otherwise SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_TicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Channel_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Reminders applicable" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="SendTask_Reminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderApplicable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_Reminder" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PostTravelFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
